snippet.title: Cryptic Tales | Crossroads - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3120510/Cryptic_Tales__Crossroads/
EPIC GAMES STORE:
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cryptic-tales-crossroads-d85c5e

Jon’s dreams were filled with music and a love life he once had. Now they’ve curdled into nightmares, weaving between memories and unknown realms. Set in the '90s, this immersive first-person psychological walking simulator follows Jon as he realizes… something is stalking him.
